title: acp/1 report
description: Describes the dict actually returned/persisted by FileTransport.report() / Conversation.report() in agent-comms/src/acp (there is no Pydantic model for Report yet; it is built as a plain dict). Reconciled with the Report record in docs/agent-communication-protocol.md's 'Core model and envelope' table: see docs/decisions.md (2026-09-29, both the original 'M1.1 schema/implementation reconciliation' entry and its 'M1.1 schema/implementation resolutions' follow-up) for what changed on each side to get here. This is a *different* shape from the one the separate, non-acp/1 handoff_compat.py legacy shim persists to $FACTORY_DIR/reports/ (that shim keeps its own pre-existing, workshop-derived report shape and is intentionally out of scope for this schema).

message_id.description: Ties this report to the message (usually an assignment) it answers.

status.description: Open string. Canonical examples from the doc (acp.models.CANONICAL_STATUSES): implemented, review-pass, review-fail, blocked-access, needs-human, failed, acknowledged. "pass", "fail" and "blocked" are also in live use (see checks/verified below) as a generic, domain-agnostic convention -- this is not a closed enum in either direction.

checks.description: A map of check-name -> exit code (e.g. {"pytest": 0}).

verified.description: True when every value in `checks` is 0. By design, also True when `checks` is empty (no checks run, nothing failed) -- this is a documented, deliberate quirk of the vacuous-truth semantics of `all(...)` over an empty collection, not a bug. Reviewers (QA discipline), not this flag, are the real backstop against an empty-check report of a passing status.
